answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 11 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 220 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The oasis is the check that cannot be faked, the nebula is the price the attacker pays, and the walnut is the record that outlives the epoch.
